d20.title: d20 roll
d20.text: Roll one twenty-sided die and add every modifier listed below. Compare the total to the target number.

advantage.title: Advantage
advantage.text: Roll two d20 and use the higher. A roll can't be affected by more than one Advantage, and Advantage and Disadvantage on the same roll cancel each other.

disadvantage.title: Disadvantage
disadvantage.text: Roll two d20 and use the lower. A roll can't be affected by more than one Disadvantage, and Advantage and Disadvantage on the same roll cancel each other.

mod.title: {ability} modifier
mod.text: The {ability} score of {score} gives a modifier of {mod}. The modifier is (score - 10) divided by 2, rounded down.

mod.attack.title: {ability} modifier
mod.attack.text: Attack rolls add the ability modifier the weapon or spell uses. The {ability} modifier here is {mod}.

mod.damage.title: {ability} modifier
mod.damage.text: Damage usually adds the same ability modifier as the attack roll. The {ability} modifier here is {mod}.

mod.initiative.title: {ability} modifier
mod.initiative.text: Initiative is a Dexterity check. The {ability} modifier here is {mod}.

prof.title: Proficiency bonus
prof.text: Proficient creatures add their proficiency bonus. At level {level} the bonus is {prof}. At challenge rating {cr} the bonus is {prof}.

prof.proficient.title: Proficiency bonus
prof.proficient.text: This creature is proficient, so it adds its proficiency bonus once. At level {level} the bonus is {prof}. At challenge rating {cr} the bonus is {prof}.

prof.expertise.title: Proficiency with Expertise
prof.expertise.text: Expertise doubles the proficiency bonus for ability checks with this skill. A proficiency bonus can be doubled only once. At level {level} the bonus is {prof}, doubled here. At challenge rating {cr} the bonus is {prof}, doubled here.

prof.half.title: Half proficiency
prof.half.text: Jack of All Trades: you add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to an ability check that uses a skill proficiency you lack. At level {level} the bonus is {prof}. At challenge rating {cr} the bonus is {prof}.

prof.attack.title: Proficiency bonus
prof.attack.text: An attack roll adds the proficiency bonus when the attacker is proficient with the weapon or spell attack. At level {level} the bonus is {prof}. At challenge rating {cr} the bonus is {prof}.

extraBonus.title: Extra bonus
extraBonus.text: A bonus added by a feature, item or effect on your character.

ruleBonus.title: Bonus
ruleBonus.text: A bonus from an effect, feature or setting on the creature or item. Each source and its rule are listed below.

bonus.title: Bonus
bonus.text: A bonus from a feature, effect or item that applies to this kind of roll.

weaponMagic.title: Magic weapon bonus
weaponMagic.text: A magic weapon with a plus value adds it to the attack roll and to the damage roll.

ammoMagic.title: Magic ammunition bonus
ammoMagic.text: Magic ammunition with a plus value adds it to the attack roll and to the damage roll.

situational.title: Situational bonus
situational.text: A bonus or penalty entered by the player or GM for this roll only.

toHit.title: To-hit bonus
toHit.text: A bonus to hit set on the weapon, spell or activity.

cover.title: Cover
cover.text: Half Cover gives +2 and Three-Quarters Cover gives +5 to AC and Dexterity saving throws, against attacks and effects from the other side of the cover. Only the best degree of cover counts.

alert.title: Alert
alert.text: The Alert feat adds your proficiency bonus to your initiative roll.

deathBonus.title: Death save bonus
deathBonus.text: A bonus that applies to your death saving throws.

concentrationBonus.title: Concentration bonus
concentrationBonus.text: A bonus that applies to Constitution saves made to maintain concentration.

hitDie.title: Hit Die
hitDie.text: Spend a Hit Die to recover hit points. Roll the die and add your Constitution modifier. The result is at least 1 with the current rules.

dmgBase.title: Weapon or spell damage dice
dmgBase.text: The dice listed on the weapon, spell or feature. Roll them and add the modifiers below.

dmgVersatile.title: Versatile damage dice (two-handed)
dmgVersatile.text: A Versatile weapon uses its larger damage die when you attack with it in two hands.

dmgExtra.title: Extra damage
dmgExtra.text: Additional damage dice from a feature, effect or a second damage part of the weapon or spell.

magicalBonus.title: Magic weapon damage bonus
magicalBonus.text: A magic weapon with a plus value adds it to damage.

ammoBonus.title: Magic ammunition damage bonus
ammoBonus.text: Magic ammunition with a plus value adds it to damage.

tiebreaker.title: Initiative tiebreaker
tiebreaker.text: A tiny decimal added so two combatants never tie exactly on initiative.

critical.title: Critical hit
critical.text: On a Critical Hit, roll the attack's damage dice twice and add them together, then add modifiers as normal. Extra damage dice, such as Sneak Attack, are also rolled twice.

critical.powerful.title: Critical hit
critical.powerful.text: Powerful Critical is active, so the damage dice are maximized and then rolled again and added.

critical.multiplyNumeric.title: Critical hit
critical.multiplyNumeric.text: This table multiplies flat numbers as well as dice on a critical hit.

criticalRange.title: Critical range
criticalRange.text: A natural {threshold} or higher on the d20 is a critical hit. The default is a natural 20.

halflingLucky.title: Luck (Halfling)
halflingLucky.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

elvenAccuracy.title: Elven Accuracy
elvenAccuracy.text: When you have advantage on a roll that uses Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, you roll a third d20 and keep the best. This feat is not in the 2024 Player's Handbook.

reliableTalent.title: Reliable Talent
reliableTalent.text: When you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

minimum.title: Minimum die result
minimum.text: A feature sets the lowest value a die can count as. Any lower result is raised to {minimum}.

maximum.title: Maximum die result
maximum.text: A feature sets the highest value a die can count as. Any higher result is lowered to {maximum}.

target.title: Target number
target.text: The roll succeeds if the total meets or beats {target}.

diceBonus.title: Bonus die
diceBonus.text: A feature adds this die to the roll, such as Bless or Guidance.

flatBonus.title: Source not found
flatBonus.text: Checked the character's bonus settings, the weapon's damage bonus, the activity's damage parts and every active effect on the character and the item. None hold this number, so another module or a manual edit added it. Turn on Debug logging and send the 'parts' line of this roll to name it.

naturalOne.title: Natural 1
naturalOne.text: A natural 1 on the d20 of an attack roll misses, regardless of modifiers or the target's AC.

actorDamageBonus.title: Damage bonus
actorDamageBonus.text: A bonus the character adds to every damage roll of this attack type while the named effect is active. The value comes from the class feature shown, which increases at higher levels.

itemDamageBonus.title: Item damage bonus
itemDamageBonus.text: A damage bonus set on this weapon or item.

formulaFlat.title: Fixed number in the damage formula
formulaFlat.text: This number is typed into the weapon or activity's damage formula, so dnd5e adds it as a plain number with no named source.

formulaFlat.mod.title: Fixed number in the damage formula (matches {ability} modifier)
formulaFlat.mod.text: This number is typed into the weapon or activity's damage formula. It equals the {ability} modifier ({mod}), so it is almost certainly the modifier entered by hand instead of @mod. A hand-typed modifier will not update if the ability score changes. To fix it, edit the activity's damage formula and replace the number with @mod.

activityPart.title: Activity damage part
activityPart.text: A separate damage line entered on this weapon's attack activity with a fixed value. Open the item, then the activity's Effect tab, to see or change it.

actorBonusField.title: Character bonus
actorBonusField.text: A bonus stored on the character's sheet, set by the named effect or entered in the character's bonus settings.

effectValue.title: Effect
effectValue.text: An active effect writes exactly this value. The text in brackets is the setting it changes.

flatBonus.possible.title: Bonus from {source}
flatBonus.possible.text: No setting holds this number as text, but this active effect changes damage by exactly this amount.

damageLineBonus.title: Bonus written into the damage line
damageLineBonus.text: A fixed number that is part of this spell, weapon or feature's own damage, added after the dice. Magic Missile, for example, deals 1d4 + 1 per dart.

scale.title: Class feature value
scale.text: A number from a class feature that grows with level, read from the class's level table.

item.magic-missile.title: Magic Missile: this is one dart
item.magic-missile.text: dnd5e rolled the damage for one dart. Under the 2024 Player's Handbook each dart deals its own 1d4 + 1 Force damage, and the 'roll damage once' rule only covers effects that force saving throws, which Magic Missile does not. Click the card's damage button again for each remaining dart. You get 3 darts with a level 1 slot, plus 1 dart for each slot level above 1.

healBase.title: Healing dice
healBase.text: The dice listed on the healing spell or feature. Roll them and add the modifiers below to find the hit points regained.

rageMissing.title: Rage Damage not added
rageMissing.text: The 2024 Player's Handbook gives Rage Damage to any attack that uses Strength, thrown weapons included. dnd5e only adds it to melee weapon attacks, so this total is missing it. Add +{rage} by hand.

prof.none.title: No proficiency
prof.none.text: The Proficiency Bonus is added only to saving throws, skills, tools and attacks the creature is proficient in.

notFromRules.title: Not from a Player's Handbook rule
notFromRules.text: No rule for this kind of roll produces this number, and no bonus setting, item or effect on the creature holds it. It is recorded in the roll log for review.

addedAfterBuild.title: Added after the roll was set up
addedAfterBuild.text: This amount was added to the roll after its parts were set, so it has no rule source. It is recorded in the roll log for review.

ac5eBonus.title: Bonus from Automated Conditions 5e
ac5eBonus.text: Automated Conditions 5e added this bonus because the named effect or condition applies to this roll.

actorAttackBonus.title: Attack bonus
actorAttackBonus.text: A bonus the character adds to attack rolls of this type, from a feature, item or effect.

defenses.title: Resistance, Immunity and Vulnerability
defenses.text: Resistance halves damage of that type (round down). Vulnerability doubles it. Immunity means no damage of that type. These apply when the damage is applied to the target, not to the roll.

cantripUpgrade.title: Cantrip Upgrade
cantripUpgrade.text: This cantrip's dice grow with character level: they increase at levels 5, 11 and 17. At level {level} the dice shown here are rolled.

condition.blinded.title: Blinded condition
condition.blinded.text: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

condition.charmed.title: Charmed condition
condition.charmed.text: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

condition.deafened.title: Deafened condition
condition.deafened.text: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

condition.exhaustion.title: Exhaustion condition
condition.exhaustion.text: When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level. Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level. Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels.

condition.frightened.title: Frightened condition
condition.frightened.text: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight. You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

condition.grappled.title: Grappled condition
condition.grappled.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.

condition.incapacitated.title: Incapacitated condition
condition.incapacitated.text: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. Your Concentration is broken. You can't speak. If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

condition.invisible.title: Invisible condition
condition.invisible.text: If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.

condition.paralyzed.title: Paralyzed condition
condition.paralyzed.text: You have the Incapacitated condition. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

condition.petrified.title: Petrified condition
condition.petrified.text: You have the Incapacitated condition. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. You have Resistance to all damage. You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

condition.poisoned.title: Poisoned condition
condition.poisoned.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

condition.prone.title: Prone condition
condition.prone.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.

condition.restrained.title: Restrained condition
condition.restrained.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

condition.stunned.title: Stunned condition
condition.stunned.text: You have the Incapacitated condition. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

condition.unconscious.title: Unconscious condition
condition.unconscious.text: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

rulePenalty.title: Penalty
rulePenalty.text: A penalty from an effect on the creature, such as a spell or condition. Each source and its rule are listed below.
